quotes.author: Austin Duty
quotes.text: Jacob made our Boston helicopter tour an unforgettable experience. From the moment we took off his professionalism and confidence put us completely at ease. There was a lot going on in the sky during our flight but he kept his cool the entire time and handled everything smoothly. He was clearly very skilled and focused on giving us a safe and smooth ride while still making it exciting. The views were incredible and you could tell we were in good hands the whole time. If you are thinking about doing a helicopter tour over Boston, ask for Jacob. You will not regret it. Five stars all the way.

quotes.text: Great vibes from everyone at the company! Beautiful sunset flight and my pilot Brandon was very professional and gave me an experience I will never forget. Wonderful birthday gift for my significant other! 10/10 would recommend.
